name: dsh-local-model-long-prefill
description: Fixes the undici headersTimeout abort, the OpenAI SDK per-request timeout (default 600s → 'Request timed out.' at exactly +10 min), and the pi-ai stream idle watchdog for local OpenAI-compatible providers (LM Studio, vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, etc.). On every load the plugin SELF-HEALS the OpenAI SDK patch (node:http, no timeout) and automatically rewrites settings.yaml to raise BOTH timeoutMs AND streamIdleTimeoutMs for local/LAN providers — no manual config editing required.
